title: Senior Software Engineer – Video Encoding
description: As a Senior Software Engineer – Video Encoding, you will play an important role in developing our video ingest, encoding, and transcoding systems. You will work on high-performance systems that prepare live and on-demand content for delivery across a wide range of devices. We are looking for an experienced C++ engineer who can contribute hands-on, participate in technical design, mentor other engineers, and help us grow a dedicated Video Encoding team. What you'll have here: In-house products: Working on products that we use everyday and have millions of users. Some of them are your friends, neighbours, and family members. We are our own clients. Our opinions and experiences are directly shaping the products that we design and create. Physical access to latest generation server infrastructure in our Video Laboratory department. Meaningful technical contribution: You will work closely with other experienced engineers, contribute to design decisions, and help improve the architecture and engineering practices of our encoding platform. Engineering mindset: Through our advanced problem-solving skills, we engineer our solutions from the ground up using open-source tools and customizing them to our needs. We worry about performance, we analyze and observe our system. We are not throwing money at the problem, we actually care if things could be more optimal. Learning and growth: We support knowledge sharing, internal learning sessions, research initiatives, innovation challenges, and individual development plans. Your responsibilities: Design, develop, and optimise video ingest, encoding, transcoding, and processing components. Participate in technical design and architecture discussions. Integrate, customise, and extend FFmpeg-based solutions. Investigate complex issues related to video quality, performance, synchronisation, and compatibility. Build near-real-time systems with a focus on latency, scalability, and reliability. Mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. Collaborate with infrastructure, streaming, player, product, and other development teams. Evaluate new codecs, hardware platforms, and video-processing technologies. What we're looking for: At least five years of professional software engineering experience. Strong hands-on experience with modern C++. Practical experience with FFmpeg and video-processing pipelines. Strong understanding of video encoding, transcoding, and compression. Knowledge of codecs such as H.264, H.265, AV1, AAC, and AC-3. Familiarity with formats and protocols such as MPEG-TS, MP4, CMAF, HLS, and MPEG-DASH. Experience building high-performance, multithreaded, or near-real-time applications. Strong understanding of latency, concurrency, memory management, profiling, and optimisation. Experience developing software for Linux or other POSIX systems. Ability to independently solve complex technical problems. Experience contributing to technical design decisions and mentoring other engineers. Professional proficiency in English. What will be considered as a bonus: Experience with large-scale or distributed video-processing systems. Experience with live video and adaptive bitrate encoding workflows. Knowledge of DCT-based compression and optimisation techniques. Experience with GPU, FPGA, ASIC, or other hardware acceleration. Experience with hardware encoders or vendor-specific media SDKs. Knowledge of HDR, colour spaces, pixel formats, deinterlacing, or video-quality measurement. Contributions to FFmpeg or other open-source multimedia projects. We have more than cookies: Flexible working environment – we have offices in Belgrade and Ljubljana. Gifts for your special days. “Healthy” Friday – not always healthy snacks on Fridays. 🙈 25 vacation days. 🏝
